$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-brp-haalcentraal-source). Seeds the pre-built `brp-haalcentraal` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister BRP person-lookup integration leaf (BrpPersonProvider SOURCE_ID='brp-haalcentraal'). The RvIG HaalCentraal Personen v2.0 API authenticates with OAuth2 client_credentials AND mutual-TLS (PKIoverheid). Both are first-class on OpenConnector's CallService: the bearer is injected per-call via the `{{ oauthToken(source) }}` Twig placeholder in `configuration.headers.Authorization` (AuthenticationService::fetchOAuthTokens, grant_type=client_credentials), and the client certificate / private key flow through `configuration.cert` + `configuration.ssl_key` (CallService::getCertificate writes them to temp files for Guzzle's TLS handshake). MOCK MODE (integration-mock-mode): ships with `configuration.mock:true` + a realistic `configuration.mockResponse` (HaalCentraal `/personen` shape, a FAKE test BSN 999990019 — a RvIG test-range BSN, NOT a real person) + a `configuration.mockMeta` (status 200 / durationMs / a fake correlationId) and isEnabled:true, so the leaf is demonstrably functional end-to-end WITHOUT OAuth2 credentials or a PKIoverheid certificate — the OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter short-circuits the mock-flagged source (via callWithMeta) and returns the canned body + synthesized Wet-BRP audit meta without any HTTP call. To go live against the production HaalCentraal v2 endpoint: paste your RvIG client_id/client_secret, scope, and PEM cert+key onto `configuration.authentication` + `configuration.cert`/`configuration.ssl_key`, and REMOVE `configuration.mock` (the EMPTY credential / cert fields are pre-shaped; base + token URLs are already the production endpoints). No end-user input reaches the request URL (the BSN travels in the POST body, never the path), so there is no SSRF surface — the base URL is admin-owned on the source. BSN values are PII (AVG art. 9 adjacent): the consuming app (pipelinq) masks them before logging; this source never logs the request body (logBody defaults off).

objects.name: BRP HaalCentraal Personen
objects.description: RvIG HaalCentraal BRP Personen v2.0 API (basisregistratie personen). Consumed by the OpenRegister BRP integration leaf (person lookup by BSN — RaadpleegMetBurgerservicenummer). Dormant placeholder — the base URL is the production HaalCentraal v2 endpoint. To enable: (1) set `configuration.authentication.client_id` / `client_secret` / `scope` (OAuth2 client_credentials, tokenUrl already set to the RvIG token endpoint); (2) set `configuration.cert` + `configuration.ssl_key` to your PKIoverheid client certificate + private key PEM (mutual TLS, required by RvIG); (3) flip isEnabled. The Authorization header is rendered per-call from `{{ oauthToken(source) }}`.
